constraint:agent_assessment_packets:agen.definition: CHECK ((((channel = 'INTRINSIC'::"AgentFeedbackChannel") AND ("purposeId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entryId" IS NULL)) OR ((channel = 'QUALITY'::"AgentFeedbackChannel") AND ("entryId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("purposeId" IS NULL))))

constraint:agent_birth_candidates:agent_.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("parentPersonaVersionId") REFERENCES agent_persona_versions(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("parentProfileId") REFERENCES agent_profiles(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((("draftVersion" > 0) AND ("policyVersion" > 0) AND (version > 0) AND (("snapshotHash")::text ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text) AND ("expiresAt" > "createdAt") AND ("expiresAt" <= ("createdAt" + '7 days'::interval)) AND (jsonb_typeof(persona) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(evidence) = 'object'::text) AND (((status = 'PROPOSED'::"AgentBirthCandidateStatus") AND ("closedAt" IS NULL) AND ("closureReason" IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'PROPOSED'::"AgentBirthCandidateStatus") AND ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closedAt" >= "createdAt") AND ("closureReason" IS NOT NULL)))))

constraint:agent_purposes:agent_purposes.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'ACTIVE'::"AgentPurposeStatus") = ("activeSlot" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("activeSlot" IS NULL) OR ("activeSlot" = ANY (ARRAY[1, 2])))))
FOREIGN KEY ("agentProfileId") REFERENCES agent_profiles(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("claimRunId") REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("creationRunId") REFERENCES agent_runs(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraint:agent_reward_assessments:agen.definition: CHECK ((((channel = 'INTRINSIC'::"AgentFeedbackChannel") AND ("purposeId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("entryId" IS NULL)) OR ((channel = 'QUALITY'::"AgentFeedbackChannel") AND ("entryId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("purposeId" IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY ("agentProfileId") REFERENCES agent_profiles(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("createdById") REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("entryId") REFERENCES entries(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("packetId") REFERENCES agent_assessment_packets(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("purposeId") REFERENCES agent_purposes(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (((applied = (("creditedSourceKey" IS NOT NULL) AND ("creditedContentHash" IS NOT NULL))) AND (applied OR (("creditedSourceKey" IS NULL) AND ("creditedContentHash" IS NULL))) AND ((NOT applied) OR ((mode = 'FULFILL_SLOT'::"AgentRewardMode") AND ((verdict)::text = 'SUPPORTED'::text))) AND ("expiresAt" > "sourceAt")))

constraint:agent_reward_reversals:agent_.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("assessmentId") REFERENCES agent_reward_assessments(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY ("createdById") REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraint:ukte_requests:ukte_requests_r.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("requestedById") REFERENCES users(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraint:ukte_requests:ukte_requests_s.definition: CHECK (((version > 0) AND ((length(("normalizedTitle")::text) >= 2) AND (length(("normalizedTitle")::text) <= 100)) AND ((cardinality("targetKeys") >= 1) AND (cardinality("targetKeys") <= 6)) AND (("normalizedTitle")::text = ANY ("targetKeys")) AND (((status = 'OPEN'::"UkteStatus") AND ("closedAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status <> 'OPEN'::"UkteStatus") AND ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closedAt" >= "createdAt")))))

function:reject_immutable_history_mutati.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_immutable_history_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only', TG_TABLE_NAME;
END;
$function$
